D003376.s: The giving of advice and assistance to individuals with educational or personal problems.

D003462.s: An island in the Greater Antilles in the West Indies, south of Florida. With the adjacent islands it forms the Republic of Cuba. Its capital is Havana. It was discovered by Columbus on his first voyage in 1492 and conquered by Spain in 1511.

The presence of Lewy bodies is the histological marker of the degenerative changes in lewy body disease and parkinson disease but they may be seen in other neurological conditions.

D019739.s: Autologous skeletal muscle that is wrapped around the heart and electrically stimulated in order to provide mechanical heart assistance.

D019920.s: Biologically active molecules which are covalently bound to the enzymes or binding proteins normally acting on them. Binding occurs due to activation of the label by ultraviolet light. These labels are used primarily to identify binding sites on proteins.
